title: Glass supporting top rail.
officialText:
When the top rail is supported by glass, the assembly shall be tested according to the impact
requirements of Section 1609.1.3. The top rail shall remain in place after impact.
SECTION BC 2408
GLAZING IN ATHLETIC FACILITIES
